services.desc: Host your next event at the historic Conestoga House & Gardens, one of the most beloved gems of the Lancaster area since the early 1700’s. Located in the heart of Lancaster, this breathtaking property is available for wedding ceremonies, receptions, corporate events, and private celebrations. Ecklin Events is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all guests and couples.
